LESSON: DANCE

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.4: Dance

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Dance, part of Strand 1 in Grade 2 MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: when dancing?
